blocking_reason: The legacy label_available_at value is derived from a post-event 0.99/0.01 market-price crossing. A price crossing is not independent proof that an authoritative final result was publicly observable at that timestamp.
required_repair: Join every retained event to an independently timestamped authoritative final-result publication, preserve the raw result receipt and hash, and require as_of < event_time < label_available_at.
